cancel: Cancel button of the dialogs on a person's page (deactivate, transfer, make owner, remove).
done: Button that closes the transfer dialog after the transfer.
page.tryAgain: Button on a person's page after it failed to load.
page.needsSignIn: Shown instead of a person's page when the workspace has no sign-in set up, so there are no real accounts.
page.loading: Shown while a person's page loads.
page.notFound: Shown instead of a person's page in Settings › People when no person in this workspace has that account (the address points to nobody).
page.loadFailed: Error shown instead of a person's page when it can't be loaded and the server gave no message.
page.joined: After the person's email in the page header: when their account was made. {{date}} is a short date ("Oct 2").
page.more: Accessible name of the ⋯ menu button. {{name}} is the person's name.
page.makeOwner: Hands the workspace ownership to this admin. Only the current owner sees it.
page.removePermanently: Menu item and footer button that open the dialog to delete the person for good; the ellipsis says a dialog follows.
page.nowOwner: Toast after the ownership was handed over. {{name}} is the new owner's name.
tiles.lastActive: Four stat tiles at the top of a person's page: a short label over a value and a small note.
tiles.signedInOn: Tile label: on how many devices the person is signed in now.
tiles.deactivated: Tile note under Signed in on, when the account is deactivated. Lowercase.
tiles.actsForThem: Tile label: what acts on the person's behalf (socios, the AI agents, and connected outside agents).
tiles.actsForThemValue: {{socios}} and {{agents}} are already-counted phrases ("2 socios", "1 agent").
tiles.nowhere: Tile note: the person is signed in on no device now.
tiles.canReach: Tile label: how many Spaces the person can see.
tiles.asEditor: Tile note under Can reach: in how many of those Spaces the person is an editor.
tiles.delegated: Tile note under Acts for them: socios and agents act with access the person delegated. Lowercase.
tabs.access: Tab on a person's page: the Spaces, socios (AI agents), agents and groups the person can use.
tabs.sign-in: Tab: the devices the person is signed in on and the ways they sign in.
tabs.owns: Tab: everything the person owns (apps, schedules, data) that can be handed to someone else.
tabs.activity: Tab on a person's page: the audit log lines about them.
footer.title: Footer card of a person's page. {{first}} is their first name. The _deactivated forms show when the account is already deactivated.
footer.description: Under the footer card's title, beside the Deactivate button; the _deactivated form is beside Reactivate.
access.unknown: Shown on the Access tab. {{first}} is the person's first name; a workspace user is made when they first sign in.
access.levelFailed: Error toast on a person's Access tab when changing their level (member or editor) in a Space failed and the server gave no message.
access.spaces: A Space is a product noun: a shared area for a team's pages and chats.
access.addForm: Accessible name of the form that adds the person to a Space.
access.addSelect: Accessible name of the select of the Space to add the person to.
access.addPlaceholder: First, empty option of the select of the Space to add the person to.
access.addRole: Accessible name of the select of the person's role (member or editor) in the Space being added.
access.add: Button that adds the person to the chosen Space.
access.roleIn: Accessible name of the role select beside a Space. {{space}} is the Space's name.
access.removeFrom: Accessible name of the × button beside a Space. {{space}} is the Space's name.
access.levels.editor: A person's level in a Space: editor (may change it), member, or everyone (an open Space).
access.levels.member: A person's level in a Space: may see and take part, but not change the Space itself.
access.levels.everyone: A person's level in an open Space that everyone in the workspace can see.
access.private: After a Space's name: only its members see it.
access.everyone: After a Space's name: everyone in the workspace sees it.
access.noSpaces: Shown on the Access tab when the person is in no Space.
access.adminEverywhere: Muted note under the Spaces list. {{first}} is the person's first name.
access.actors: Card title: socios (AI agents) and connected outside agents that act for the person, and whether they may run code.
access.removedSocio: Stands in for a socio's (AI agent's) name once it was removed.
access.grantName: A socio's access grant, named in the revoke confirmation. {{socio}} is the socio's (AI agent's) name.
access.revoke: Button beside a socio's access grant: ends it at once, after a confirmation.
access.grant: One socio access grant: a socio (AI agent, {{socio}} is its name) may use {{audiences}} (models, git, an app…) on behalf of {{first}}.
access.grantAnything: Stands in for the list of what a socio may use, when the grant lists nothing in particular.
access.grantMeta: Muted note after a grant: its kind and its expiry date.
access.audiences.models: What a socio's access covers, inserted into "may use … for": AI models, Git, an app, a plugin.
access.audiences.git: What a socio's access covers, inserted into "may use … for": Git (code repositories). Lowercase.
access.audiences.app: What a socio's access covers, inserted into "may use … for": one mini app.
access.audiences.plugin: What a socio's access covers, inserted into "may use … for": one plugin.
access.disconnect: Button beside a connected outside agent (such as Claude Code): cuts its connection, after a confirmation.
access.agentKind: Muted note after a connected agent's name; the _domain form adds the website it connected from.
access.codeAccess: Row label on the Access tab: whether the person may run code.
access.codeAccessVia: Why the person may run code: as an admin, or through a group with the "Run code" permission.
access.yes: Badge beside Code access: the person may run code.
access.no: Badge beside Code access: the person may not run code.
access.groupsLink: Link to Settings › Groups, where code access is given through groups.
access.telegram: A row on the person's Access tab: their Telegram link (a messaging app; keep its name), its status beside it.
access.telegramLinked: Badge beside Telegram: the person linked their Telegram account.
access.telegramNotLinked: Badge beside Telegram: the person has not linked a Telegram account.
access.telegramSince: After a Telegram username: when they linked Telegram (a messaging app). Keep the parentheses.
access.groups: Card title on the Access tab: the groups the person is in.
access.remove: Button that takes the person out of a group; also the confirm button that removes them from a Space.
access.leaveFailed: Error toast on a person's Access tab when taking them out of a group failed and the server gave no message.
access.left: Toast after the person was taken out of a group. {{first}} is their first name; {{group}} is the group's name.
access.noGroups: Shown on the Groups card when the person is in no group.
access.removeTitle: Title of the confirmation before removing the person from a Space. {{first}} is their first name; {{space}} is the Space's name.
access.removeBody: Body of the confirmation before removing the person from a Space. {{first}} is their first name.
access.removeFailed: Error toast on a person's Access tab when removing them from a Space failed and the server gave no message.
access.revokeTitle: Title of the confirmation before ending a socio's access. {{name}} is the grant's name (access.grantName).
access.disconnectTitle: Title of the confirmation before cutting a connected agent's connection. {{name}} is the agent's name.
access.revokeBody: Confirmation body: the socio's access or the connected agent stops working for {{first}} at once.
access.revokeFailed: Error toast on a person's Access tab when ending a socio's (AI agent's) access grant failed and the server gave no message.
access.disconnectFailed: Error toast on a person's Access tab when disconnecting an outside agent (such as Claude Code) failed and the server gave no message.
dates.revoked: A service key's standing: withdrawn on {{date}}, a short date. Lowercase.
dates.expires: A service key's or a password link's standing, with a short date.
dates.expired: A service key's or a password link's standing: it stopped working on {{date}}, a short date. Lowercase.
assets.apps.title: Kinds of things a person owns, which can be transferred to another person: a title, a count, and what moves.
assets.apps.count: How many mini apps the person owns.
assets.apps.what: Line under Mini apps in the transfer dialog: what moves. The apps' data space (bundles and datasets) belongs to the app's owner, so it moves with them.
assets.schedules.title: Kind of things a person owns: scheduled tasks, saved jobs and goals.
assets.schedules.count: How many schedules (scheduled tasks, saved jobs, goals) the person owns.
assets.schedules.what: Line under Schedules in the transfer dialog: scheduled tasks, saved jobs and goals move, together with the chats they run in.
assets.socios.title: Socios (AI agents) the person made for themselves.
assets.socios.what: Line under Personal socios in what a person owns, on their page in Settings › People: the socios (AI agents) they made for their own use.
assets.socios.count: How many socios (AI agents) the person made for themselves.
assets.spaces.title: Kind of things a person has that can be transferred: their memberships in Spaces.
assets.spaces.count: How many Spaces the person is a member or editor of.
assets.spaces.what: Line under Spaces in the transfer dialog: the person's membership in each Space, as member or editor. "Space" is a product noun; keep it capitalized if your language allows.
assets.data.title: Their data space: datasets, files and media.
assets.data.count: How many items of their data space (datasets, files, folders…) the person owns.
assets.data.what: Line under Data space in the transfer dialog: what moves, namely datasets (private scratch areas too), files and media, folders, embeds, and the access grants the person gave.
assets.conversations.title: Kind of things a person owns: their own chats, not Rooms.
assets.conversations.what: Line under Conversations in what a person owns, on their page in Settings › People: their private chats, which don't include Rooms.
assets.conversations.count: How many of their own chats the person owns.
assets.memories.title: Kind of things a person owns: what socios (AI agents) remember about their work.
assets.memories.count: How many memories socios (AI agents) keep about the person's work.
assets.memories.what: Memories are what socios (AI agents) remember about the person's work.
